scope: Compared all five feature claims and the full Japanese article with twelve translations; checked history, memory-safety wording, platform support, Cargo, dates, and links against current official Rust documentation.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates and retained publication date 2022-10-03; added lastmod 2026-11-24.

Corrected the outdated statement that Mozilla develops Rust: it began as a Mozilla Research project, while project direction and governance have been independent of Mozilla since 2015; the project is now community-governed with Rust Foundation support.
Scoped memory-safety guarantees to ordinary safe Rust and added a warning that unsafe code and foreign-language interfaces need careful review.
Clarified that Rust platform support levels and guarantees vary by target.
Expanded Cargo from “package manager” to its package-management, build, and test roles; added five official references in every locale.

post/Rustの特徴/index.en.md.summary: Reviewed the complete feature overview against Japanese and official Rust documentation, updated project governance, scoped memory-safety claims to safe Rust, clarified target tiers and Cargo’s role, and added official references.

meaning.note: Compared the complete feature list in every locale and corrected the outdated statement that Mozilla currently develops Rust; retained that Rust originated at Mozilla and is now an independent community-governed project.

terminology.note: Checked ownership, borrowing, references, safe versus unsafe Rust, garbage collection, target/platform support tiers, and Cargo as package manager and build tool.

mathematics.note: The overview contains no mathematical formulas or calculations.

code.note: The overview contains no executable code or commands.

links.note: Added and opened official Rust references for project history/governance, ownership, Cargo, platform support, and Unsafe Rust.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
Safety guarantees depend on the safe/unsafe boundary and soundness of unsafe code and foreign interfaces.
Platform support tiers can change; the article links to the current Rust target support policy.
